newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Intellect shares smarten up on deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Intellect shares smarten up on deal.

text.p: Shares in Perth-based transactions technology developer, Intellect Holdings Ltd, climbed to a two year high of A$1.10 on Wednesday as investors bought in after recent announcements of new contracts, brokers said.

On February 3, Intellect said it had joined with NCR Corp in a A$4 million plus deal to design and install EFTPOS terminals in Myer Grace department stores, a division of retail giant, Coles Myer Ltd.

On January 28, it announced the involvement of its U.S. subsidiary, Intellect Electronics Inc, with Siemens Components Inc and YourNet Inc in a U.S. smart-card project Intellect is to supply its 8515 multi-function payment terminal to the new network as part of a multi-million dollar contract.
"They will probably announce more later in the year but these deals have been well received so far," said a Perth-based broker.
By 11.55 a.m. (0055 GMT), Intellect shares were 10 cents higher at A$1.10 on turnover of 185,900 shares.
